### Combined treatment and follow-up by G6PD status

| **G6PD normal: no definition** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Implemented | Treatment is based on G6PD status determined at birth when screening conducted | _Not reported_ | DOT in hospital, then after discharge, patients are monitored at the primary care level (health centre or health office) and reporred through an online system | Implemented | _Not reported_ |

| **G6PD severely deficient: no definition** | No PQ | Implemented | Treatment is based on G6PD status determined at birth when screening conducted | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ |
| **If no testing available** | Risk-assessment | Implemented | Treatment is based on G6PD status determined at birth when screening conducted | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ |
:::

<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Policy note</h4>
<p>Program is not considering Point-of-Care G6PD testing since there are so few vivax cases - too much investment for little impact. In the new guidelines being approved this year, the guideline are updated to 7-day low dose PQ (0.5mg/kg/day).</p>
